description.value: The Heatley is a community pub on East Hastings Street in East Vancouver, self-described as the neighbourhood homebase since 2015 and known for an inclusive, diversity-celebrating atmosphere. It hosts a regular live events calendar and has earned press coverage from The Daily Hive and The Globe and Mail. The pub serves a casual shareable-food menu alongside a full bar, making it a solid stop for a post-ride pint in a genuinely local venue.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 50m; rack at 56m; rack at 62m; rack at 69m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at heatley.ca is live and confirms the business name, address (696 East Hastings St.), and phone number matching OSM tags, establishing the pub as a real, open East Vancouver venue since 2015. The menu pages explicitly flag multiple items as vegetarian (V), vegan, and gluten-free (GF), confirming that amenity. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM opening hours appear to differ from those listed on the website (weekend hours in particular); the website version is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Heatley is a real, active, publicly accessible pub with a live website, confirmed address, and a full menu — a straightforward inclusion for touring cyclists seeking food and drink in East Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels multiple items V (vegetarian), GF (gluten-free), and vegan — e.g. Heatley House Salad (V & GF), Kale Caesar with vegan caesar dressing, Heatley Burger with vegan Impossible Burger option, Veggie Chilli (V & GF)

wow_evidence: press coverage from The Daily Hive and The Globe and Mail
